title: The Mysterious 1764

hints.text: Walk the New Orleans Square side of the Rivers of America and inspect the themed masonry.
You're looking for a four-digit year worked into a bricked-up architectural detail.
Find the sealed-looking wall detail marked 1764 along the riverfront.

revealDescription: The riverfront detail is marked 1764, an atmospheric reference tied to the history and architectural influences of New Orleans.
